family_name: Bradford Wall Wraps - Light Duty Metal Roof

spec.description:
Bradford Thermoseal Light Duty Metal Roof / Wall is a
multi-layer reflective foil laminate sarking designed specifically for use under
metal roof claddings and in exterior walls. Manufactured from kraft paper
laminates bonded to aluminium foil with flame-retardant adhesives and reinforced
with continuous fibreglass yarn, it features a green anti-glare coating on one
face to reduce installation glare. Installed adjacent to an air cavity, it
provides dual reflective thermal R-values while acting as a water barrier,
vapour barrier, and draft-reducing membrane in metal residential and light
commercial buildings.
features:
Specifically formulated for metal roof
and external brick veneer wall applications

Green anti-glare finish on
outward-facing surface minimizes glare during daytime installation

Provides
an effective vapour barrier (Class 1 / 2) to control condensation

Functions
as a water barrier to direct moisture and wind-driven rain away from the roof
space

Reflective aluminium foil facing contributes thermal air-gap R-values
in summer and winter

Reinforced with fibreglass yarn for enhanced tear
resistance during fixing

Non-combustible aluminium facings with low
Flammability Index (≤ 5)

Suitable for use in bushfire BAL-12.5 to BAL-40 roof
systems

install:
Roll out perpendicular or parallel to
purlins/rafters with green anti-glare facing outward/upward

Allow a
nominal 40mm drape between roof battens to maintain reflective airspace and
water drainage

Overlap adjoining sheets by minimum 150mm in roofs (or 50mm if
taped)

Fasten securely to battens, purlins, or studs using approved
galvanized staples or fasteners

Seal overlaps with 48mm or 72mm Bradford
reinforced aluminium foil tape for maximum vapour performance

Ensure foil
drains freely into gutters without ponding or reverse laps
selection_checklist:
Confirm roof type is metal deck or corrugated sheeting
(not recommended under concrete tiles without safety mesh)

Calculate roll
requirement based on 1350mm width (40.5m² or 81m² rolls) allowing 150mm
overlaps
Confirm need for anti-glare coating to comply with safety on site
Check requirement for BAL rating up to BAL-40

Order matching Bradford 493
reinforced foil tape for sealing
limitations:
Light Duty rating: when used on roofs,
unsupported span must not exceed manufacturer limits without safety mesh

Not
a substitute for primary roof cladding; must be covered promptly

Ensure an
air space exists adjacent to reflective foil to generate rated thermal R-value
spec.warranty: Backed by CSR Bradford product warranty

retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Wall Wraps - Light Duty Metal Roof (Bradford
Thermoseal Roof Metal Wall, product codes 105871 / 15056) is a reinforced
reflective foil laminate sarking engineered for metal-clad roofs and external
walls. Combining kraft paper, reinforcing fibreglass scrim, and pure aluminium
foil with a green anti-glare finish on the outer face, it reflects up to 95% of
radiant heat when installed adjacent to an air cavity. Functioning as a
Class 1/2 vapour barrier and water barrier with a Flammability Index ≤ 5
(suitable up to BAL-40 under AS 3959), it protects buildings from storm rain,
dust, and summer solar gain.
